title: A Registered Cohort Study on Wilson's Disease
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine the clinical spectrum and natural progression of Wilson's Disease in a prospective multicenter natural history study, to assess the clinical, genetic, epigenetic features and biomarkers of patients with Wilson's Disease to optimize clinical management.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with the genetic diagnosis of Wilson's Disease
* Asymptomatic Wilson's Disease carriers
* Relatives of Wilson's Disease patients or carriers
* Unrelated healthy controls
* Participants or Parent(s)/legal guardian(s) willing and able to complete the informed consent process

Exclusion Criteria:

\* Participants are unable to comply with study procedures and visit schedule
study_population: Patients with Wilson's Disease are diagnosed by the clinical and/or genetic features
